mapper.select: SELECT c.*, p.bg_color, p.product_name, p.product_en_name, p.thumbnail, p.label_type, p.label_country, p.label_grapevariety, p.price_discount, p.price_original, p.price_deal, p.price_deal_price, p.price_deal_amount FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_code = p.product_code WHERE c.memberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.cart_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE cart_no = #{cart_no}
UPDATE cart SET packing = #{packing} WHERE cart_no = #{cart_no}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN p.stock >= c.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM product p JOIN cart c ON p.product_code = c.product_code WHERE c.cart_no = #{cart_no}
SELECT stock FROM product WHERE product_code = #{product_code}
